verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance data and payments API platform, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so plugging external MCP servers into it is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows Belvo publishes its own MCP servers for Cursor and VS Code to connect to. That is the MCP-server role, which belongs to a separate story and does not show Belvo acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
